content.text:
I've submitted index 26 (Sb fraction 0.757) as the best composition, but its lead is probably noise: every composition I measured gave essentially zero EQE.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 0.182 | 0.00002 |
| 12 | 0.342 | −0.00005 |
| 18 | 0.523 | 0.00001 |
| 23 | 0.670 | 0.00002 |
| 26 | 0.757 | 0.00033 |

The zeros fit the chemistry. The Mg–Sb–O phases on this line (MgO, MgSb₂O₆, Mg₄Sb₂O₉) have wide band gaps, far above the 2.1 eV illumination, so light shouldn't be absorbed anywhere on the line. Index 26 reads about ten times higher than the others, which might hint at weak absorption at the Sb-rich end. It rests on a single measurement at a tiny absolute value, so I wouldn't rely on it.

I spent all 5 EQE measurements spread across the line and didn't use the XRD budget or the Gaussian-process suggestions. With no signal anywhere, XRD wouldn't have told me which composition to measure next. The 22 unmeasured compositions are unlikely to do meaningfully better.
